title: Residue generation by normalized irreducible factors
statement: Let $K\subseteq L=K(t)$ be a rational function field extension [def-pc-field-extension], let $O\subseteq L$ be a valuation subring, and put $R=O\cap K$. Assume that every element of $L^\times$ can be multiplied by an element of $K^\times$ to become a unit of $O$. Then $\kappa(O)$ is generated as a field over $\kappa(R)$ by the residues of elements $f(t)/\pi\in O^\times$ where $f\in K[t]$ is monic irreducible and $\pi\in K^\times$ is chosen so that $f(t)/\pi$ is a unit. Consequently, if $\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(R)}\kappa(O)=1$, at least one such normalized residue is transcendental over $\kappa(R)$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree]. Here $K$ is a field [def-weil-field], $K[t]$ is the polynomial ring in one indeterminate [def-weil-polynomial-ring], and a valuation subring $B$ of a field $F$ is a subring with $x\in B$ or $x^{-1}\in B$ for every $x\ne0$. Write $\mathfrak m_B=B\setminus B^\times$ and $\kappa(B)=B/\mathfrak m_B$ for its maximal ideal and residue field.
